statement: On an AboveAnchor leftover, the first cube-odd landing x with even T(x) satisfies x^3 < n^8. False. For n=4309 the first cube-odd state is x=22357213525 after the leftover-generated prefix OOEOOEOO, T(x) is even, and T^2(x)=57818025 >= 4309^2. The same word appears on the long leftover n=5791. Named leftovers 365, 501, 1517, 6187 remain below n^8 at their first lift because those itineraries keep 3^{o+1} < 8*2^{|w|}; OOEOOEOO is the first PE prefix that loses the gap. This is not a claim about later landings, not a new exponent chain, and not a halt theorem.
